<Update label="v0.34.3" description="September 2, 2026">

**Partner Node Updates**

</Update>

<Update label="v0.34.2" description="August 27, 2026">

**Partner Node Updates**

</Update>

<Update label="v0.34.0" description="August 26, 2026">

**New Open-Source Model Support**
* [**Pixal3D & TRELLIS2**](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/14718): 3D mesh and texture generation with remesh, decimate, UV unwrap, texture bake
* [**SAM 3D Body**](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/14370): Dependency-free 3D body detection and segmentation with pose rendering and animation export
* [**TAESD H3**](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15695): Lightweight VAE decoder for faster previews

**Partner Node Updates**
* [**PixVerse V6**](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15880): Added V6 text-to-video, image-to-video, first-last-frame, extend, fusion nodes with native audio
* [**Tripo**](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15851): Removed the retired Refine Draft model node and v2.0 model version

</Update>

<Update label="v0.33.4" description="August 24, 2026">
